bail_taxonomy.note: Three distinct reasons an eval can bail before scoring. Only the two that involve the drainage clip carry registration information about the DEM and are folded into the 'all_cases' clip-fraction view; the third never reached the clip at all and is excluded rather than assigned a fraction.
bail_taxonomy.empty_release_area: No cell ever passed the elevation/slope/thickness release filters -- there was no release polygon for the drainage clip to act on. Carries zero clip-registration information (nothing was clipped, because nothing was there to clip). Excluded entirely from clip-fraction statistics, not folded in at any fraction. Observed once in this batch: t1_structure_2018hold's aval_6866.
bail_taxonomy.clip_floor_refusal: A release band existed and the drainage clip trimmed it, but the surviving cell count fell below the refusal floor (20 cells) -- e.g. '82% removed, 18 cells left' or '96% removed, 9 cells left'. This is a genuine (if extreme) clip-fraction observation and is folded into 'all_cases' at its parsed fraction. Observed twice: t1_structure_1999's aval_8653 (0.96) and t1_structure_campaign's aval_8124 (0.82, the same real case seen refused in every prior campaign stage).
bail_taxonomy.total_clip_loss: The drainage clip removes the release band completely (100% removed, 0 cells survive) -- distinct from clip_floor_refusal only in degree (it is the floor case pushed to its limit) and distinct from empty_release_area in kind (a release band existed before the clip acted on it). Would be folded in at frac=1.0 if observed, same treatment as clip_floor_refusal. Not observed in any of the four t1 panels in this batch.

all_cases.note: identical to 'scored': aval_6866 is excluded (empty_release_area, zero registration information), not folded in. Corrected 2026-07-29 -- an earlier version of this file inferred frac=1.0 for aval_6866 and folded it in, which the design agent flagged as a reporting artifact (it inflated the mean from 0.0392 to 0.0488). That was wrong: an empty release area was never clipped, so it has no clip fraction to contribute.
